title: Write design/link.md: findings, decisions, tolerances and words for Link
description:
## Intent
Turn the three spikes into `design/link.md`, the design note every later epic follows.

## Contents of `design/link.md`
- **What Link shares and doesn't**: tempo, beat and phase within a quantum, start/stop; not song position, not the time signature.
- **Findings** from the three spike tasks (binding, RT-safe capture, host time, in-process peers, permission prompt, browser accuracy, cloud reachability).
- **Decisions**: binding; crates (`apricity-link` native-only; the clock math in `apricity-engine`); following strategy (bridge, trim, resync threshold, re-render debounce); Apricity never sets the session's tempo or start/stop, and proposes the score's tempo only when alone; the quantum defaults to the time signature; start/stop sync is on by default with `--no-start-stop` to opt out.
- **Tolerances** as numbers (proposal: native 3 ms, browser 10 ms, p99 and max).
- **Words**: Link, Link session, peer, quantum, start/stop sync, phase. Not "sync" alone (library sync) and not "follow" alone (`transpose follow`). Proposed rows for `design/vocabulary.md`.
- A Mermaid diagram of the clock path, native and browser.
- Open questions left for the owner.

## Out of scope
Code. Docs outside `design/` (each epic updates `docs/`).

## Verify
`design/link.md` exists; `grep -c "Decisions" design/link.md` ≥ 1; the owner's agreement on tolerances is a comment on apricitus-2e6ec4. Reviewer reads it against the three spike comments.

Label `daw`. Commit: `docs(<this task id>): design/link.md` (not a release-bearing change). Blocked by the three spike tasks.
